_about: Hand-maintained part of the CMA data map. Every table in schema cma has one entry under a group; every computed view in cma_read (not a table view, not dq_*) has one entry under derived. flows are the paths the page draws: per source its box (src, a data-id in template.html, null when it has none), its ways in (ways, data-ids) and the groups it fills (doms, group keys); every group is in at least one flow. Columns come from schema.json, never from here. Edit, then run node tools/datamap/build.mjs.

tables.name: crm_record
tables.what: Deals and tickets: pipeline, stage, owner, market, closed
tables.how: HubSpot webhook, read back within seconds; nightly reconcile 02:30

tables.name: crm_contact
tables.what: Thin contact: country with the slot it came from, language, currency, store
tables.how: Read when a deal, ticket, email or inbox thread points to it (the email poll every minute, once, after the email or thread), every country slot; re-read every 10 min in its first hour; nightly reconcile

tables.name: crm_contact_ref
tables.what: A contact's ids in other systems, such as its Shopify id

tables.name: crm_call
tables.what: Call engagements logged on the contact

tables.name: crm_association
tables.what: Links between CRM objects, such as deal to contact
tables.how: With every read-back, and the email poll's engagements (email to contact, deal, ticket)

tables.name: form_submission
tables.what: Form submissions: form, page, UTM, contact id only

tables.name: crm_task
tables.what: Tasks: owner, status, type, priority, due and completed times, the contact, deal and ticket by id; never body or subject
tables.how: HubSpot webhook (task creation, deletion, status, due, owner, completion, type, priority, associations), read back within seconds; nightly reconcile 02:30; backfill by hand (since 0008n)

tables.name: connection_task_status
tables.what: Task statuses seen per connection, with is_done as configuration
tables.how: Seeded by the first task read of each status ref; is_done and the label set on Configuration, Sources

tables.name: connection_task_type
tables.what: Task types seen per connection, with is_callback and is_counted as configuration
tables.how: Seeded by the first task read of each type ref; is_callback and is_counted set on Configuration, Sources

tables.name: email_message
tables.what: Emails, metadata only: CRM email engagements and inbox messages kept apart; direction, status, time, actor kind, the agent's owner id, category
tables.how: Email poll every minute (engagements modified since its cursor; inbox messages of changed threads), the nightly reconcile (last 26 hours) and the backfill; only when the connection's email_poll is on

tables.name: email_thread
tables.what: Inbox conversations: inbox, channel, open or closed, the current agent, contact and ticket ids, spam
tables.how: Email poll every minute (threads whose latest message is newer than its cursor; every ten minutes the open check), the nightly reconcile with the trash check, the backfill; only when the connection's email_poll is on

tables.name: email_thread_event
tables.what: Assignments, closes, reopens and inbox moves of conversations: actor kind and owner ids only
tables.how: Email poll every minute (with the messages of changed threads), the nightly reconcile and the backfill; only when the connection's email_poll is on

tables.name: telephony_call
tables.what: Calls: direction, start, answer, end, talk time, missed reason, line, user
tables.how: Aircall webhook per call event, call read back within seconds; nightly check; backfill by hand

tables.name: telephony_call_tag
tables.what: Tags on each call

tables.name: telephony_number
tables.what: Lines, their market and whether they count
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly; counting set on Configuration

tables.name: telephony_tag
tables.what: Tag catalog and whether a tag counts
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly; counting set on Configuration

tables.name: telephony_missed_reason
tables.what: Missed-reason labels, service level and callback switches

tables.name: call_link
tables.what: Aircall call matched to its HubSpot call
tables.how: Sweep every minute, over the last 2 hours

tables.name: commerce_store
tables.what: One row per Shopify store: market, currency, zone

tables.name: commerce_customer
tables.what: Customer: state, order count, spend, matched CRM contact
tables.how: Shopify webhook, read back within seconds; nightly check; backfill per store

tables.name: commerce_order
tables.what: Order: amounts, status, kind (first, repeat, renewal), landing page, UTM
tables.how: Shopify webhook, read back within seconds; nightly check; backfill per store

tables.name: commerce_order_line
tables.what: Order lines: SKU, quantity, price

tables.name: integration_connection
tables.what: One row per connected account (portal, Aircall account, store)

tables.name: connection_pipeline
tables.what: CRM pipelines, counted or routed; a ticket pipeline's own SLA in business minutes (0008o)
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly; switches and the SLA on Configuration

tables.name: connection_stage

tables.name: connection_call_outcome

tables.name: connection_form

tables.name: connection_field

tables.name: writeback_field

tables.name: connection_inbox

tables.name: connection_inbox_channel
tables.what: Channels of the CRM's conversations (email, chat, ...): the CMA channel, counted

tables.name: connection_email_rule

tables.how: Configuration (the functions of 0008m; the screen comes with B17c)
